brief: A field with the mirror-symmetric lengthwise sequence red(9)-green(1)-yellow(1)-blue(1)-red(1)-black(2)-white(7)-black(1)-green(1)-red(1)-white(7) scaled to 64 cells, crossed at right angles by two solid black bands of width 4 at one-third and two-thirds of the height that fully occlude the stripes, with a row of four small yellow triangles centred in each wide white stripe; seven inks.
